extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent practitioners, applicants, and patent attorneys
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the USPTO Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) Eighth Edition, Revision 2 (May 2004), linking to chapters and appendices that set forth legal standards, procedural rules, and examiner guidance across the full range of patent practice topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: the latest published version of the patent laws (Appendix L of the MPEP or Consolidated Patent Laws, whichever is more current).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the controlling statutory law text used throughout the MPEP; see Appendix L or the Consolidated Patent Laws for current statutory provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: the latest published version of the patent rules (Appendix R of the MPEP or Consolidated Patent Rules, whichever is more current).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the controlling procedural rules used throughout the MPEP; see Appendix R or the Consolidated Patent Rules for current rule text.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain a copy of the MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on formats (PDF, HTML, zipped files, Blue Pages) and ordering the Manual (DVD-ROM, paper) including contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative guidance on obtaining and subscribing to the MPEP in various formats; not substantive patent law but important for accessing complete guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0100 - Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: 100 Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP chapter covering secrecy orders, classified invention handling, access restrictions, and rules for foreign filing and required government interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0200 - Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: 200 Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers different kinds of patent applications (provisional, utility, reissue, etc.), cross-noting procedures, and application status considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0300 - Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses legal principles and procedures relating to title, assignment, recordation of assignments, and ownership disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0400 - Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on who may represent applicants before the USPTO, power of attorney, practitioner qualifications, and related procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0500 - Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: 500 Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for filing, receipt dates, correspondence handling, and related timing issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0600 - Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: 600 Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and requirements for specification, claims, drawings, oath/declaration, and formalities required in a patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0700 - Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner procedures, patentability analysis, office actions, interviews, amendments, and prosecution practice guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0800 - Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: 800 Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and procedures for restriction requirements, unity of invention, and double patenting rejections and cures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0900 - Prior Art, Classification, Search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for prior art, searching techniques, classification of inventions, and how prior art is applied in examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 - Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: 1000 Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and precedents relating to decisions by USPTO officials and internal administrative review processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 - Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: 1100 Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and procedures for SIRs and pre-grant publication of patent applications, including effects on rights and prior art status.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 - Appeal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for appeals from examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) and further appellate review.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 - Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and procedures for allowance, issuance of patents, issue fees, publication, and post-allowance formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 - Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and procedures for correcting errors in issued patents (reissue, certificate of correction, reexam, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 - Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substantive and procedural guidance specific to design patent applications and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 - Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and procedures applicable to plant patent filings and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 - Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Miscellaneous topics not categorized elsewhere; procedural and substantive guidance for varied topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on PCT filings, national stage practice, international search and examination interactions with USPTO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 - Protest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for third-party protests against pending patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 - Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for disclosure of relevant information (duty of candor) by applicants and practitioners, including what must be submitted and sanctions for failures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 - Patentability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substantive patentability criteria including novelty, non-obviousness, statutory subject matter, enablement, written description, and other related doctrines.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 - Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: 2200 Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for third-party prior art citation, ex parte reexamination processes, and standards for initiating and conducting reexams.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 - Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and standards concerning priority contests (interferences) for applications and patents (historically applicable pre-AIA).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 - Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialized guidance on biotechnology-related patentability issues, disclosures, deposits, and examiner considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 - Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements, timing, and procedures for payment of maintenance fees to keep patents in force.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2600 - Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for inter partes reexamination (optional) and related third-party challenge mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 - Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and calculations for patent term, adjustments, patent term extension for regulatory delay, and related relief.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference appendix listing trademarks referenced in the MPEP; informational only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compilation of cases and decisions cited in the manual for reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text of applicable patent statutes; primary legal authority referenced throughout the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text of applicable patent rules (CFR/PTO rules); primary procedural authority referenced in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text and guidance relating to the PCT as it affects U.S. practice; reference for international filing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative instructions implementing the PCT and their application to U.S. procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text and guidance on the Paris Convention provisions relevant to priority claims and international considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject index for locating topics within the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blue Pages / Title / Foreword / Introduction / Table of Contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Site navigation items (Blue Pages, Title, Foreword, Introduction, Table of Contents) and linked materials for the Complete MPEP and its revisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Front-matter, publisher notes, and navigational aids to access MPEP content and understand scope and revisions.
